last_run: Built 'the outside view'. Before someone taps how sure they are, the How sure card now shows how often calls like theirs have come true: e.g. of 2,651 graded bullish calls, 42% beat the S&P 500 at the 90-day check (bearish: 59%). It counts each call once, the same way your calibration score grades you, and says it's mostly the app's practice calls and the past, not a forecast. If someone says 90% on a call type that works 42% of the time, it says so plainly, no advice. Shown in chat and on My beliefs. Information only: nothing about picks or trading changed.
